subject: [PATCH nfs-utils v3 01/11] mountd: factor out the per-path export attribute computation

2026-09-14.patch_summary: This patch refactors the computation of per-path export attributes in the mountd service to make it more modular and reusable. The patch introduces a new function `export_attrs_build` that takes an export path and an export entry as input and returns a struct containing the computed export attributes. This function is used by both the upcall and downcall paths, making it easier to manage cross-mount subdirectories and re-exported filesystems. No functional changes are made, only code organization improvements.
